_about: Pane tails captured READ-ONLY from a live fleet on 2026-10-13 (tmux capture-pane -p -J, the last lines the monitor classifies — it reads the last 6 non-empty lines). Scrubbed before entering the repo: hostnames, user names, paths, branch and repository names, and the prose of a finished review are replaced with neutral placeholders of the same shape; every glyph, separator, status-bar token and the word that mis-fired are byte-for-byte what the pane drew. These are the six tails behind one review finding: three Claude Code panes whose status line carries the mode word, one bash prompt after a codex review, one Claude Code permission dialog, and codex's own menu (the CODEX_UPDATE_PROMPT fixture captured 2026-08-25 stands for the sixth). Each tail also states the context figure claudeCodeProfile.contextPct must read from it: the three Claude status lines draw it as a bar (ctx:[#########-]90%, ctx:[########--]79%, ctx:[#######---]67% — null before the bar form was read, when the regex knew only ctx:NN%), the bash prompt and the permission dialog carry no token.
